title: PackageRequest
description: Names the FINAL render to package. Deliberately minimal: every other input — the approval, the QA report, the rights records, the lineage, the contract set — is read from committed artefacts rather than accepted from the caller, because a caller-supplied evidence field is a caller-supplied claim.

jobId.description: Becomes a directory name under `project-data/jobs/`. The pattern is defence in depth — `jobDir()` in @cutdown/skill-runtime guards and containment-checks it regardless of caller, because a skill's `entrypoint` is a documented direct invocation.

finalRenderId.description: The `renderId` of the final-tier render to deliver. A draft render id is accepted here and REFUSED with its tier named — telling the operator what is wrong beats pretending the id does not exist. Must be a ULID: it becomes a FILENAME under the job (and, for outputs, a directory that is created on the way), so a traversing value would read or write inside another job. The skill asserts it again before joining, because a skill's `entrypoint` is a documented direct invocation and a schema-only guard has the same bypass shape the Phase 2 HIGH had.
